dedupe_keys.name: vehicle trajectory and pavement behavior data

description: Chenxi Chen publishes a three-file package combining vehicle trajectories and pavement-condition variables for a traffic–pavement study. Zenodo serves it under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. One workbook extracts NGSIM observations from eastbound Interstate 80 at Emeryville over five minutes on 13 April 2005, with vehicle positions, classes, speeds, acceleration, lanes and headways. An XML file holds CARLA and SUMO connected-vehicle trajectories, and a CSV derives cracking, patching and roughness measures from the Long-Term Pavement Performance database. A modeller can compare simulated following behaviour with a measured traffic trace or connect traffic loading to pavement-deterioration scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this combined package. A limitation is that the I-80 clip is short and old, while the simulated connected vehicles and LTPP table are different populations. The files were not downloaded, so record counts and the study’s linking assumptions were not independently checked.
